_doc: Wave-4 WRITE recipes: how a PERSON performs each open W4 write subject (<table>.<op>) and each open mutating-rpc subject through the page's OWN control, so tools/w4_action_walk.js can live it in the browser and tools/w4_write_drive.py can read the persisted effect and reverse it through postgres. A walk never writes through PostgREST or calls a mutating rpc itself; the only writer is the page's control pressed by a seeded local persona (never ianphone). Authored 2026-10-08 from the page sources + pg_proc/pg_trigger (read-only); gated by tools/validate_w4_write_recipes.py.

_contract.steps: ordered; each one of {click: sel} {fill: sel, value} {select: sel, value} {check: sel} {waitFor: sel} {nav: 'page.html?...'} {confirm: true} - plus {upload: sel, filename, content} (Playwright setInputFiles with an in-memory file) used only by the CMMS-import recipes. Selectors are Playwright locators: CSS plus :has-text("W4M") to pick the seeded row (every run mark starts W4M; {MARK} is substituted in step values, nav AND selectors - each row its own mark). whConfirm/whPrompt (utils.js) are custom dialogs: their OK is the step {click: '[data-wh-modal-ok]'} and their text field '[id^="wh-modal-ov-"] input'.
_contract.expect: {method, path}; path is matched with endsWith on the URL without its query. on_load: true marks a request the page makes WHILE LOADING (no control exists): the walker must match requests made since it ARRIVED on the page, not only those after the first step.
_contract.sql: placeholders {MARK} {SINCE} {HIVE} {USER} {NAME} everywhere; {ID} {IDS} {BEFORE} in reverse_sql / reverse_check_sql (and {BEFORE} is also used by a few effect_sql). before_sql prints ONE jsonb object (one key per snapshot); reversal/seed SQL runs in one transaction with session_replication_role = replica, so undoing a press fires no new triggers (no fresh audit / XP / outbox rows) - which is why every side-effect row is removed explicitly. The cast's auth uid is (select id from auth.users where email = '{USER}@auth.workhiveph.com').
_contract.role: worker | supervisor: which cast member the press needs (the driver signs in ONE person per group, the supervisor when any recipe in the group needs one). actor: {user, name} names a non-cast seeded local account the press needs instead (platform admin) - the driver must sign in as it. 'anon' (2026-10-08): walked SIGNED OUT (prep --anon) - a story that exists only for a stranger (the landing page's e-mail form, the sign-up form). 'newcomer': walked by a fresh account the walker creates through the sign-up form (prep --newcomer), for a story only a person with no hive history can live; its reversal deletes the account. {USER}/{NAME} are then that account's username and display name.
_contract.seed_by_press: a delete recipe whose deleted rows are created by an EARLIER step of the same walk (the product's own create-then-undo); stands in for seed_sql and is flagged in the report.
_contract.no_write: an rpc subject whose pg_proc body writes nothing (volatile by declaration): reclassify it as a read.
_contract.alternatives: full recipes for the same subject on a DIFFERENT page, for rows whose path does not contain the primary page; the driver should use the first recipe whose page is on the row's path.
_contract.flags: (2026-10-08) last: <n> - pressed after the whole path has been walked, in ascending n (true = 1): a write that ends the person's session (deactivate_my_account, 9) or MOVES the active hive (leave 1, join_hive_by_code 2, create 3 - pressed mid-path they stranded every later row outside the cast's hive) or SIGNS SOMEONE IN (the anonymous sign-up, worker_profiles.insert, 5 - it would turn the rest of a signed-out walk into a newcomer's). Each starts from the cast's own hive. stub_model: '<edge fn>' - the walker answers that function from a context route with a canned reply (never a model call), removed when the walk ends. permissions: ['notifications'] - granted to the context for the walk and cleared after it. aliases: ['{MARK} Name'] - names the person may carry after the recipe renames them, so the identity check follows the person, not the name.
_contract.marks: (2026-10-08) every ROW of a walk gets its own {MARK} (tools/w4_write_drive.py cmd_prep): its seed, typed values, effect/reversal SQL and its SELECTORS use it - {MARK} IS substituted in selectors too (the walker's runRecipe), so a press can only reach the row its own recipe seeded. Every before_sql snapshot is taken before any seed runs; the bank reads every effect first, reverses last-in-first-out, and proves each reversal on the final state.
_contract.if_shown: (2026-10-08) a click step may carry if_shown: true - a control the page offers only sometimes (asset-hub's 'Show Reliability Workbench' toggle, whose state persists per device). The walker presses it when visible within 4s and otherwise records it as not offered; it never counts as the recipe's interaction. Name the CLOSED state in the selector so an open panel is never toggled shut.
_contract.live_model: true on a recipe whose effect is written only after a MODEL reads what the person gave it (a resume, an audio clip): the walk is sent without the no-model switch, on the local runtime's free-tier chain, and the receipt says so. Every other recipe keeps the switch (2026-10-13).
_contract.fake_mic_fixture: {fake_mic: true, fixture: '<kind>/<file>'} plays that real clip (listed in _fixtures/<kind>/manifest.json) once into the generated microphone, 0.3 s in, so a voice control hears what a person said; plain {fake_mic: true} is a quiet tone. A fixture is allowed on an upload or a fake_mic step only (2026-10-13).

accept_service_request.seed_sql: begin; set local session_replication_role = replica; insert into public.service_providers (id, provider_type, auth_uid, worker_name, display_name, contact, availability) values (md5('{MARK}m')::uuid, 'freelancer', (select id from auth.users where email = '{USER}@auth.workhiveph.com'), '{NAME}', '{MARK} Me', '09170000000', 'online'); insert into public.service_requests (id, client_auth_uid, client_worker_name, hive_id, segment, mode, custom_scope, budget, address, status, matched_provider_id, accepted_at) values (md5('{MARK}')::uuid, (select u.id from auth.users u join public.worker_profiles wp on wp.auth_uid = u.id where u.email like '%@auth.workhiveph.com' and u.email not like 'ianphone%' and u.id <> (select id from auth.users where email = '{USER}@auth.workhiveph.com') and wp.deactivated_at is null order by u.created_at limit 1), '{MARK} Client', '{HIVE}', 'industrial', 'instant', '{MARK} seeded job', null, 'Manila', 'broadcasting', null, null); commit;
accept_service_request.before_sql: select jsonb_build_object('tr', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by t.id::text) from public.credit_treasury t where true), '[]'::jsonb))::text;
accept_service_request.effect_sql: select id from public.service_requests where id = md5('{MARK}')::uuid and status = 'accepted' and matched_provider_id in (select id from public.service_providers where auth_uid = (select id from auth.users where email = '{USER}@auth.workhiveph.com'));
accept_service_request.reverse_sql: begin; set local session_replication_role = replica; delete from public.service_job_events where request_id = md5('{MARK}')::uuid; delete from public.service_payments where request_id = md5('{MARK}')::uuid; delete from public.service_offers where request_id = md5('{MARK}')::uuid or provider_id = md5('{MARK}m')::uuid; delete from public.credit_reservations where request_id = md5('{MARK}')::uuid; delete from public.service_credit_ledger where ref_id = md5('{MARK}')::uuid or (account_type = 'provider' and account_id = md5('{MARK}m')::uuid); delete from public.service_credit_topups where account_type = 'provider' and account_id = md5('{MARK}m')::uuid; delete from public.schedule_items where id = 'svc-' || md5('{MARK}')::uuid::text; delete from public.logbook where id = 'log-' || substr(md5(md5('{MARK}')::uuid::text || 'svc-writeback'), 1, 12); delete from public.service_outbox where created_at >= '{SINCE}' and (payload::text like '%' || md5('{MARK}')::uuid::text || '%' or payload::text like '%{MARK}%'); delete from public.service_requests where id = md5('{MARK}')::uuid; delete from public.service_providers where id = md5('{MARK}m')::uuid; delete from public.credit_treasury where true; insert into public.credit_treasury select * from jsonb_populate_recordset(null::public.credit_treasury, $wb${BEFORE}$wb$::jsonb->'tr'); commit;
accept_service_request.reverse_check_sql: select (coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by t.id::text) from public.credit_treasury t where true), '[]'::jsonb) = $wb${BEFORE}$wb$::jsonb->'tr') and not exists (select 1 from public.service_requests where id = md5('{MARK}')::uuid) and not exists (select 1 from public.service_providers where id = md5('{MARK}m')::uuid) and not exists (select 1 from public.schedule_items where id = 'svc-' || md5('{MARK}')::uuid::text) and not exists (select 1 from public.service_offers where request_id = md5('{MARK}')::uuid);
accept_service_request.seed_cleanup_sql: begin; set local session_replication_role = replica; delete from public.service_job_events where request_id = md5('{MARK}')::uuid; delete from public.service_payments where request_id = md5('{MARK}')::uuid; delete from public.service_offers where request_id = md5('{MARK}')::uuid or provider_id = md5('{MARK}m')::uuid; delete from public.credit_reservations where request_id = md5('{MARK}')::uuid; delete from public.service_credit_ledger where ref_id = md5('{MARK}')::uuid or (account_type = 'provider' and account_id = md5('{MARK}m')::uuid); delete from public.service_credit_topups where account_type = 'provider' and account_id = md5('{MARK}m')::uuid; delete from public.schedule_items where id = 'svc-' || md5('{MARK}')::uuid::text; delete from public.logbook where id = 'log-' || substr(md5(md5('{MARK}')::uuid::text || 'svc-writeback'), 1, 12); delete from public.service_outbox where created_at >= '{SINCE}' and (payload::text like '%' || md5('{MARK}')::uuid::text || '%' or payload::text like '%{MARK}%'); delete from public.service_requests where id = md5('{MARK}')::uuid; delete from public.service_providers where id = md5('{MARK}m')::uuid; commit;
accept_service_request.note: Seller console -> 'Services' tab -> 'Accept job' on an instant request in 'Open requests near you' (svcAccept -> rpc accept_service_request). Budget left null so the job has no price and no credit hold is required. Tables written: service_requests (accepted + matched provider), service_offers (the accept offer), service_providers.availability on_job, schedule_items (the job lands on the provider's dayplan), service_job_events, service_outbox (client push). Seeds (triggers off): a freelancer provider identity '{MARK} Me' for the CAST (auth_uid = the cast), and - where a job is needed - a request md5('{MARK}') '{MARK} seeded job' from another seeded local account (never ianphone; a provider cannot take their own request). Null locations and no catalog item, so it is in the provider's v_service_open_broadcasts feed. The reversal deletes everything keyed to the request and to the seeded provider (offers, events, reservations, ledger, top-ups, the dayplan item 'svc-<id>', the logbook write-back row, outbox pushes) and restores credit_treasury. ★2026-10-08: the rpc takes only the request id and acts as the CALLER's provider identity; in a walk where a sibling recipe seeded a second identity for the same person, either may answer, so the effect is keyed by this row's request and 'one of the caller's identities', and each identity is still removed by the reversal of the recipe that seeded it.

ai_reply_feedback.insert.note: Ask the AI assistant a question, wait for the reply, then thumbs-up it (_recordChatFeedback -> INSERT ai_reply_feedback; a daily per-user cap trigger applies). The thumbs only exist under a LIVE reply, so the press needs one ai-gateway model call first - stub it at context level (a page walk must not spend model calls) or accept one free-tier call. The feedback press itself writes only ai_reply_feedback; the SEND press before it writes the gateway's own telemetry (ai_cost_log, wh_traces, ai_cache, ai_rate_limits / ai_user_rate_limits, hive_route_calls, agent_memory / agent_episodic_memory) - not reversed here. Alternatives: the companion launcher's and voice handler's reply ratings write the same table.

alert_dismissals.delete.effect_sql: select '{MARK}' where exists (select 1 from public.inventory_items where id = 'w4-{MARK}') and not exists (select 1 from public.alert_dismissals where hive_id = '{HIVE}' and alert_key = 'stock:{MARK} seed part');
alert_dismissals.delete.reverse_sql: begin; set local session_replication_role = replica; delete from public.alert_dismissals where hive_id = '{HIVE}' and alert_key = 'stock:{MARK} seed part'; delete from public.inventory_items where id = 'w4-{MARK}'; commit;
alert_dismissals.delete.reverse_check_sql: select not exists (select 1 from public.inventory_items where id = 'w4-{MARK}') and not exists (select 1 from public.alert_dismissals where alert_key like 'stock:{MARK}%');
alert_dismissals.delete.seed_cleanup_sql: begin; set local session_replication_role = replica; delete from public.alert_dismissals where hive_id = '{HIVE}' and alert_key like 'stock:{MARK}%'; delete from public.inventory_items where id = 'w4-{MARK}'; commit;
alert_dismissals.delete.note: The person's delete is the 'Seen' toggle pressed a second time ('Unsee', acknowledgeAlert -> DELETE alert_dismissals ... action=eq.acknowledged). The seed makes a real alert to un-see: an approved out-of-stock part '{MARK} seed part' (qty 0, min 5 -> a 'stock:' alert) plus an 'acknowledged' dismissal for it, so the feed shows it dimmed with the Unsee control. Tables written by the press: alert_dismissals only (the un-see writes no audit row). Alternative person path: 'Handled' then the toast's 'Undo' (a DELETE too, plus two audit rows). The page reads v_inventory_items_truth with an UNORDERED .limit(150): in a hive holding more than 150 parts the seeded part can fall outside the read.

alert_dismissals.upsert.seed_sql: begin; set local session_replication_role = replica; insert into public.inventory_items (id, worker_name, part_number, part_name, qty_on_hand, min_qty, status, hive_id, submitted_by) values ('w4-{MARK}', '{NAME}', '{MARK}', '{MARK} seed part', 0, 5, 'approved', '{HIVE}', '{NAME}'); commit;
alert_dismissals.upsert.effect_sql: select d.id from public.alert_dismissals d where d.hive_id = '{HIVE}' and d.alert_key = 'stock:{MARK} seed part' and d.action = 'handled' and exists (select 1 from public.hive_audit_log a where a.hive_id = d.hive_id and a.action = 'alert_handled' and a.target_id = d.alert_key and a.created_at >= '{SINCE}');
alert_dismissals.upsert.reverse_sql: begin; set local session_replication_role = replica; delete from public.alert_dismissals where hive_id = '{HIVE}' and alert_key like 'stock:{MARK}%'; delete from public.hive_audit_log where hive_id = '{HIVE}' and action = 'alert_handled' and target_id like 'stock:{MARK}%'; delete from public.inventory_items where id = 'w4-{MARK}'; commit;
alert_dismissals.upsert.reverse_check_sql: select not exists (select 1 from public.alert_dismissals where alert_key like 'stock:{MARK}%') and not exists (select 1 from public.hive_audit_log where hive_id = '{HIVE}' and action = 'alert_handled' and target_id like 'stock:{MARK}%') and not exists (select 1 from public.inventory_items where id = 'w4-{MARK}');
alert_dismissals.upsert.seed_cleanup_sql: begin; set local session_replication_role = replica; delete from public.alert_dismissals where hive_id = '{HIVE}' and alert_key like 'stock:{MARK}%'; delete from public.inventory_items where id = 'w4-{MARK}'; commit;
alert_dismissals.upsert.note: 'Handled' on an alert of the row's OWN: the seed is an approved out-of-stock part '{MARK} seed part' (qty 0, min 5), which the feed raises as the stock alert 'stock:{MARK} seed part' (alert-hub.html dismissAlert -> UPSERT alert_dismissals onConflict hive_id,alert_key + hive_audit_log 'alert_handled'). ★2026-10-08: the first version pressed 'the first not-seen alert', which in a walk beside alert_dismissals.delete was that row's just-unseen seed - the 'handled' dismissal then erased the delete row's evidence (W47 stayed open). A real alert of the hive is never touched now. An 'Undo' button stands in the toast for 8 s; the recipe does not press it. Reversal: the seeded key's dismissal, its audit row and the seeded part, all by mark.

amc_briefings.update.seed_sql: begin; set local session_replication_role = replica; insert into public.amc_briefings (hive_id, shift_date, status, brief, generated_at, expires_at) values ('{HIVE}', (now() at time zone 'Asia/Manila')::date, 'pending', jsonb_build_object('w4_mark', '{MARK}', 'headline', '{MARK} seeded brief', 'top_assets', '[]'::jsonb, 'pm_due', '[]'::jsonb, 'parts_to_stage', '[]'::jsonb), now(), now() + interval '36 hours') on conflict (hive_id, shift_date) do nothing; commit;
amc_briefings.update.before_sql: select jsonb_build_object('amc', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by t.id::text) from public.amc_briefings t where t.hive_id = '{HIVE}'), '[]'::jsonb))::text;
amc_briefings.update.effect_sql: select id from public.amc_briefings where hive_id = '{HIVE}' and shift_date = (now() at time zone 'Asia/Manila')::date and status = 'approved' and approved_at >= '{SINCE}';
amc_briefings.update.reverse_sql: begin; set local session_replication_role = replica; update public.amc_briefings t set status = b.status, approved_by = b.approved_by, approved_at = b.approved_at from jsonb_populate_recordset(null::public.amc_briefings, $wb${BEFORE}$wb$::jsonb->'amc') b where t.id = b.id; delete from public.amc_briefings where hive_id = '{HIVE}' and brief->>'w4_mark' = '{MARK}'; delete from public.hive_audit_log where hive_id = '{HIVE}' and action in ('approve_amc_brief', 'reject_amc_brief') and created_at >= '{SINCE}'; commit;
amc_briefings.update.reverse_check_sql: select not exists (select 1 from public.amc_briefings where brief->>'w4_mark' = '{MARK}') and (select coalesce(bool_and(row(t.status, t.approved_by, t.approved_at) is not distinct from row(b.status, b.approved_by, b.approved_at)), true) from jsonb_populate_recordset(null::public.amc_briefings, $wb${BEFORE}$wb$::jsonb->'amc') b join public.amc_briefings t on t.id = b.id) and not exists (select 1 from public.hive_audit_log where hive_id = '{HIVE}' and action in ('approve_amc_brief', 'reject_amc_brief') and created_at >= '{SINCE}');
amc_briefings.update.seed_cleanup_sql: begin; set local session_replication_role = replica; delete from public.amc_briefings where brief->>'w4_mark' = '{MARK}'; commit;
amc_briefings.update.note: 'Approve brief' on today's AMC brief card (actOnAmcBrief), then the whConfirm dialog's OK ('Approve brief'). Supervisor-only in the page (HIVE_ROLE) and in the trigger tg_bind_approved_by. The seed inserts today's pending brief ONLY when the hive has none for today (unique hive_id,shift_date); if today's brief already exists and is not pending, the approve button stays hidden and the row stays open. Tables written: amc_briefings (status/approved_by/approved_at) + hive_audit_log ('approve_amc_brief'). amc_briefings has GENERATED columns (asset_count/pm_count/parts_count), so the reversal restores the three written columns by id instead of re-inserting rows.

anomaly_signals.update.seed_sql: begin; set local session_replication_role = replica; insert into public.anomaly_signals (hive_id, snapshot_date, machine, composite_score, source_count, severity, top_reasons, status, computed_at) values ('{HIVE}', (now() at time zone 'Asia/Manila')::date, '{MARK} machine', 99, 2, 'critical', '[{"label": "{MARK} seeded signal"}]'::jsonb, 'active', now()); update public.hive_readiness set current_stair = 3 where id = (select id from public.hive_readiness where hive_id = '{HIVE}' order by snapshot_date desc, computed_at desc limit 1) and current_stair < 3; commit;
anomaly_signals.update.effect_sql: select id from public.anomaly_signals where hive_id = '{HIVE}' and machine = '{MARK} machine' and status = 'acknowledged' and acknowledged_at >= '{SINCE}';
anomaly_signals.update.reverse_sql: begin; set local session_replication_role = replica; delete from public.anomaly_signals where hive_id = '{HIVE}' and machine = '{MARK} machine'; delete from public.hive_audit_log where hive_id = '{HIVE}' and action in ('anomaly_acknowledged', 'anomaly_resolved') and created_at >= '{SINCE}' and target_name = '{MARK} machine'; update public.hive_readiness t set current_stair = (b->>'current_stair')::int from (select $wb${BEFORE}$wb$::jsonb->'hr' as b) x where x.b is not null and jsonb_typeof(x.b) = 'object' and t.id = (x.b->>'id')::uuid; commit;
anomaly_signals.update.reverse_check_sql: select not exists (select 1 from public.anomaly_signals where machine = '{MARK} machine') and not exists (select 1 from public.hive_audit_log where hive_id = '{HIVE}' and action in ('anomaly_acknowledged', 'anomaly_resolved') and created_at >= '{SINCE}' and target_name = '{MARK} machine') and (select coalesce(bool_and(t.current_stair = (x.b->>'current_stair')::int), true) from (select $wb${BEFORE}$wb$::jsonb->'hr' as b) x join public.hive_readiness t on jsonb_typeof(x.b) = 'object' and t.id = (x.b->>'id')::uuid);
anomaly_signals.update.seed_cleanup_sql: begin; set local session_replication_role = replica; delete from public.anomaly_signals where machine = '{MARK} machine'; update public.hive_readiness t set current_stair = (b->>'current_stair')::int from (select $wb${BEFORE}$wb$::jsonb->'hr' as b) x where x.b is not null and jsonb_typeof(x.b) = 'object' and t.id = (x.b->>'id')::uuid; commit;
anomaly_signals.update.note: 'Acknowledge' on the seeded signal in the Anomaly Engine panel (supervisor-only buttons; the panel lists the top 5 by composite_score, so the seed scores 99). Tables written: anomaly_signals (status/acknowledged_*) + hive_audit_log ('anomaly_acknowledged'). The seed is fresh (computed_at now), so the page's load-time compute_anomaly_signals call is NOT made on this walk. Alternative: 'Resolve' (same table, status resolved). ★STAIR 3 IS SEEDED (2026-10-08): the Anomaly Engine panel renders only at readiness Stair 3+ (maturity-gate.js; alert-hub loadAnomalyEngine returns before rendering - and before calling compute_anomaly_signals - when blocked), and every cast hive is at Stair 0-1, so no person could reach the control. The seed raises the hive's LATEST readiness snapshot to current_stair 3 for the walk; before_sql snapshots that row and the reversal puts its stair back exactly (walk it with prep under the lock and settle before releasing, so no other walker meets the raised stair).
anomaly_signals.update.before_sql: select jsonb_build_object('hr', (select to_jsonb(t) from (select * from public.hive_readiness where hive_id = '{HIVE}' order by snapshot_date desc, computed_at desc limit 1) t))::text;

The request happens during page load, BEFORE any step - expect.on_load asks the walker to match requests made since it ARRIVED on the page, not only those after the first step. Tables written: anomaly_signals (upsert on hive_id,machine,snapshot_date). If the hive has no signal above the model's threshold the rpc writes no row and the effect cannot be read - the row then stays open honestly. ★STAIR 3 IS SEEDED (2026-10-08): the Anomaly Engine panel renders only at readiness Stair 3+ (maturity-gate.js; alert-hub loadAnomalyEngine returns before rendering - and before calling compute_anomaly_signals - when blocked), and every cast hive is at Stair 0-1, so no person could reach the control. The seed raises the hive's LATEST readiness snapshot to current_stair 3 for the walk; before_sql snapshots that row and the reversal puts its stair back exactly (walk it with prep under the lock and settle before releasing, so no other walker meets the raised stair).
